decisions.decision: Capture all 11 slots now from our own local builds (run the dev server, use the preview attendee for anything in the centre). Webinar/challenge offer links: open the Dodo checkout with ?src=live and capture it before any payment details are typed. s5-rsp-stages #1: capture the contact timeline with depth tags from our own starter CRM or demo data, never Wistia. s2 #12: do a test sign-up as [email] 'Adi test' on a local build with NEXT_PUBLIC_TRACKING_DISABLED=1, at 390 px. s6-sms #1: the demo's rotation.md. Blur emails, names and IDs (team totals on the public referral dashboard can stay as they are). Save as NN.webp, remove capture_needed, run check-guides (capture-needed drops by 11) and probe-guides per guide. Commit, push to main, republish the mirror, then set the task to review for Amal. If a slot's source doesn't render, fix the page; don't fake the shot.
